scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.build:web: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --dir artifacts/library-system run build
scripts.build:server: pnpm run build:web && node scripts/copy-public.mjs && pnpm --dir artifacts/api-server run build
scripts.build:production: pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:kiosk
